headline: Cummins India shares face divergent targets from UBS and Macquarie after Q2 profit falls 27%
hook: Sharp profit drop splits analyst views

summary: Cummins India reported a 27% decline in net profit for Q2FY27, alongside a 658 basis point contraction in EBITDA margin to 15.3%. Following the results, major brokerages split sharply on the stock's valuation. UBS maintained a 'Sell' rating with a lowered target of ₹3,320, while Macquarie retained an 'Outperform' rating and a ₹5,510 target. Indian retail investors holding the stock face heightened volatility as analysts weigh margin pressures against long-term growth prospects.
